status: implemented and compared within the stated four-handler subset
scope: Internal C++ object/model subset and sequential translated-byte keyword imports. Public DB loader interfaces remain unchanged; no claim of original binary ABI or complete application replacement.
contracts: Stable object identity across list growth, sparse-ID placeholders, name/type/secondary fields, mesh-owned deactivation with retained descriptor history and arity.
Case-sensitive full-catalog lookup, bounded token and line consumption, unknown-keyword warning distinction, explicit unsupported outcome for recognized unimplemented keywords.
Object selectors use recovered integer-prefix grammar, consuming whitespace, sign and base prefix even when conversion fails. Zero-initialized destination and EOF status match captured calls.
Mutations occur immediately; failed imports retain objects and rows already written. Later successful handlers do not erase the last nonzero status.
RZ and ELMCON use recovered allocation and dependent buffers. Arity rejection happens before connectivity replacement, while object selection may already have created records.

Boundary suppression is separate from mesh marking. Normal constructor default is zero; temporary-root import can set one. Static contract establishes this branch; current end-to-end captures use zero.
Scientific/material finalization remains explicitly pending whenever requested, including after parser errors. It is never advertised as complete.

verification.qualification: Candidate source, library and replay binaries archived before the evaluation capture. New import compositions and selector edges were defined before capture; some cube/tetra component fixtures had been used earlier. Numeric model values are compared through JSON; separate row-helper captures compare raw numeric bytes.

evaluation_harness_correction.cause: Comparator initially treated a FILE buffer reset by preceding fgets EOF as logical offset zero. Corrected EOF normalization using empty versus null buffer observations. C++ implementation and frozen binaries did not change.

limitations: Only four handlers and the captured fields are reconstructed. Remaining recognized keywords stop as unsupported instead of being silently skipped.
Same-dimension headers only; changes to root dimension, linked alternate-root dispatch and their initialization side effects remain unsupported.
Explicit default root controls; nonunit multiplicities, sharing, nondefault allocation modes and complete descriptor families remain unresolved.
End-to-end comparison covers 3D default controls and small ASCII fixtures. Component-level 2D boundary evidence does not establish 2D full-import equivalence.
Input is already translated text. File opening, Windows CRLF/Ctrl-Z rules, encodings, large buffers, locale changes and numeric extremes remain separate.
Original finalizer can conditionally write root+0x990 and process materials/geometry not captured by this probe. Equality of tracked fields is not a complete no-op proof.
Model snapshots compare numeric JSON values, not all floating storage bits. Native addresses are checked for within-process identity then normalized away.
Complete model, scientific operations, output formats, editing commands and console integration remain required work under the active full-application goal.
next: Recover explicit startup/root profiles and dimension changes, then reachable finalization and the next keyword families with original-state comparisons.
